component_path_scopes.canonical_metadata: All relocated explicit whole-file paths, declaration-file coordinates and method-root file coordinates are repository-relative. Literal schema URIs and JSON pointers remain unchanged.
component_path_scopes.rule: Only this exact original component alias mapping applies to unchanged source protocol/method text; no host lookup, arbitrary prefix inference or cross-realm merge.

These unchanged whole-inherited native method metadata references retain their original native source component scope, not the new native-v7 directory. Other explicit relocated Plans/ fields are repository-relative. Whole schemas resolve only through isolated bank identities.

component_path_scopes.canonical_metadata: All relocated explicit whole-file resource/member/source citations are repository-relative. Full original legacy method/resource dependencies retain distinct literal banks and exact original scope.
component_path_scopes.rule: Consumer imports only the explicitly declared exact cross-bank edges; genuine nested owner GuardReadRequest/Result and Q1-Q4 methods remain whole.

registry_selection.three_existing_workflow_standard_rows: Unchanged actual conditional-base rows and default wrapper selections. Eleven v7 wrapper routes apply only to genuine fresh born v7 roles.

source_qualification.original_source_acquisition: Complete genuine owner entry/final source, independent Goal and guard boundaries remain mandatory; transport data, source census, role strings or hashes are not native capabilities.
source_qualification.birth: Pure candidate/preimage order followed by one actual original B1 transaction coissuing native birth, compact Birth and initial empty epoch0 Control; no separately durable or visible intermediate birth.
source_qualification.append_release: F5a before actual barriers/append custody F5b/F5c and F5d; atomic native result/origin+D01+compact Commit/Origin, then exact held release; equal original dedupe only.
source_qualification.passive_consumer: No consumer read/projection issues original sources, native actions, append, commit, release or repair. P0-P8 and full original branches remain normative.
source_qualification.historical_scopes: Operative original predecessor bodies stay complete with explicit scope dispatch. No header rollback, old birth enrollment, newest-ID substitution or original absolute host fallback.
source_qualification.retention: Exact unchanged policies; no mutable source/body archive, source-lifetime extension or deleted/expired original reconstruction.

digest_codec: SHA-256 of entire sorted-key compact UTF-8 JSON without prefix or trailing LF; external manifest/digest never in own preimage.
